records.assetReview: First tank uses vertical scale 40 px/m: initial 5 m is 200 px and half-time 5/4 m is 50 px. Widths and hole symbols are explicitly schematic. Separate speed arrows 100 and 50 px at 10 px/(m/s) give 10 and 5 m/s. Flow graph origin (110,1060), 3 px/s and 2000 px/(m³/s): triangle to (110,860),(410,1060) represents 1/10 m³/s initially, 100 s duration and 5 m³ area. The midpoint (260,1707.5) gives 50 s and 5/4 m; the curve stops at 100 s. Complete XML, markers and native rendering read.
